name: Mushikago
source:
Main character is bullied by three classmates. One day protagonist's friend is also bullied by the trio, so protagonist decides to have revenge on them. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角一直遭到三名同學欺負。一天，他的朋友也遭這三人霸凌，他決定向他們復仇。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
